snippet.title: Become the Moon - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Become the Moon is an out-of-this-world deckbuilding auto battler where you draft cards, cast spells, spawn minions, and watch the magical chaos unfold. Can you build a team strong enough to become the moon?

Play the Demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2862890/Become_the_Moon/
